description: Links every output of this project to the code, data, protocol and evidence behind it, so a person or an AI agent can trace a result back to its sources. Replace the example entries with your own. Use null where a value is unknown, never a guess.
chain: claim -> output -> code -> input data -> protocol -> evidence

project.title: A FAIR and project-oriented template for open science data workflows

inputs.description: Rankings of three video-based maize hybrid concepts by 150 farmers in Uganda, with respondent gender, age and household size
inputs.license: CC-BY-4.0, as released by the data producer
inputs.personal_data: no direct identifiers; free-text answers kept as given

protocols.name: Video-based product concept testing (VPCT) with tricot rankings
protocols.source: Methods section of Donovan et al. 2025

outputs.description: Plackett-Luce log-worth estimates and standard errors for eight maize concepts
R and package versions used in the last run

evidence.citation: Donovan J, Rutsaert P, Mawia H, de Sousa K, van Etten J (2025). Farmers' preferences for the next generation of maize hybrids. Application of product concept testing in Kenya and Uganda. Experimental Agriculture 61, e5.
Turner HL, van Etten J, Firth D, Kosmidis I (2020). Modelling rankings in R. The PlackettLuce package. Computational Statistics.
